glyph.isekai_mahou.magma_aftershock.desc: AUGMENT (Magma). Each target hit gets a ring of embers under it; 1.5 s later a magma geyser bursts there: 40% of the hit's damage to whoever stands on it (radius 1.8), Burning and a launch upward (bosses stay grounded). 1 geyser per target per second.
glyph.isekai_mahou.steam_jet.desc: AUGMENT (Steam). When you cast, a steam jet pushes you BACKWARD (sneaking: FORWARD) and grants 1 s of slow falling. Kite or dash while casting. Cheap; at most 1 jet every 0.5 s.
glyph.isekai_mahou.lightning_fork.desc: AUGMENT (Lightning). Each hit arcs to up to 3 enemies within 5 blocks of the target: 35% of the damage each, with Shocked (and Electrocute on Wet targets). Unlike Chain it does not repeat the effects, only the shock, and it is cheaper.
glyph.isekai_mahou.sun_captive_star.desc: AUGMENT (Sun, Circle 4). The target becomes a small sun for 4 s: it glows through walls and every second burns itself (Burning up to III) and flares 15% of the hit's damage at enemies within 3 blocks. Does not stack on the same target.
glyph.isekai_mahou.hellfire_hunger.desc: AUGMENT (Hellfire). Targets hit become Corrupted (up to III) and marked for 6 s. If a marked target dies, the black flames leap to the 2 nearest enemies (6 blocks): heavy Burning, Corrupted and 50% of the damage. The fire leaps for up to 3 waves, each weaker.
glyph.isekai_mahou.nature_seed.desc: AUGMENT (Nature). Plants a seed in the target. 3 s later it sprouts: Rooted for 2 s and 30% of the hit's damage. If the target already died, it blooms on the spot and heals you and allies within 4 blocks.
glyph.isekai_mahou.ice_splinter.desc: AUGMENT (Ice). Hits add +1 Chilled. On a Frozen or Chilled III target the hit deals +25%, breaks the ice and throws splinters at up to 6 enemies within 4 blocks (50% of the damage + Chilled).
glyph.isekai_mahou.purity_ablution.desc: AUGMENT (Purity). Washes 1 GOOD effect off the enemy hit (the strongest; never permanent ones). Each effect washed also removes 1 bad effect from you and restores 3% of your mana. With nothing to wash, it just makes the target Wet. Once per target every 2 s.
glyph.isekai_mahou.abyss_anchor.desc: AUGMENT (Abyss). The target is dragged down (flyers plummet) and gets Slowness II for 3 s. Targets in water take +35% damage from this spell.
glyph.isekai_mahou.sand_erosion.desc: AUGMENT (Sand). Each hit wears down the target's armor and stacks Exposed (+25% damage taken per level, up to II, for 5 s). Opens armored enemies for the rest of the party.
glyph.isekai_mahou.crystal_resonance.des: AUGMENT (Crystal, Circle 4). On impact a crystal stays humming on the spot; 1.5 s later it repeats the spell's effects at 30% power on everything within 3 blocks (up to 8 targets). +0.3 s cast time. 1 crystal every 0.5 s.
glyph.isekai_mahou.gravity_collapse.desc: AUGMENT (Gravity, Circle 4). On impact, pulls enemies within 5 blocks into the hit point; 0.5 s later the point collapses: 40% of the hit's damage and slowness to everyone within 2.8 blocks. Bosses are not pulled. 1 collapse every 0.5 s.
glyph.isekai_mahou.astral_starstep.desc: AUGMENT (Astral, Circle 4). When the spell hits a target within 24 blocks, you appear behind it in a trail of stars, already facing it. 2 s internal cooldown.
glyph.isekai_mahou.void_annihilate.desc: AUGMENT (Void, Circle 4). Creatures killed by this spell are ERASED: no items, no XP. In exchange you absorb their essence: +4% of max mana + 25% of the victim's health (up to +15%). Players and bosses are never erased (they only give the mana).
glyph.isekai_mahou.twilight_tide.desc: AUGMENT (Twilight). Each cast flips the phase: DAWN (your hits heal you for 15% of the damage dealt) and DUSK (hits apply Corrupted, up to III, and Exposed I). The phase is shown on screen when you cast.
glyph.isekai_mahou.magma_on_land.desc: TRIGGER (Magma, at the start of the recipe). The slot casts BY ITSELF when you fall 5+ blocks and hit the ground (not in water), aiming at the nearest enemy. Pressing the key does not cast it.
glyph.isekai_mahou.steam_on_vapor.desc: TRIGGER (Steam, at the start of the recipe). The slot casts BY ITSELF when one of your hits causes Vapor or Melt, or when you jump into water while on fire. Aims at the reaction's target. Pressing the key does not cast it.
glyph.isekai_mahou.lightning_on_overload: TRIGGER (Lightning, at the start of the recipe). The slot casts BY ITSELF at the target when your hit brings an enemy to Shocked III or causes Electrocute (once per target every 3 s). Pressing the key does not cast it.
glyph.isekai_mahou.sun_on_sunlight.desc: TRIGGER (Sun, at the start of the recipe). The slot casts BY ITSELF when you step from shade (cave, house, rain) into direct sunlight during the day. Pressing the key does not cast it.
glyph.isekai_mahou.hellfire_on_burn.desc: TRIGGER (Hellfire, at the start of the recipe). The slot casts BY ITSELF when you catch fire or take fire/lava damage (at most every 2 s). Pressing the key does not cast it.
glyph.isekai_mahou.nature_on_root.desc: TRIGGER (Nature, at the start of the recipe). The slot casts BY ITSELF at the enemy when one of your spells Roots someone. Pressing the key does not cast it.
glyph.isekai_mahou.ice_on_freeze.desc: TRIGGER (Ice, at the start of the recipe). The slot casts BY ITSELF at the target when one of your spells Freezes an enemy, perfect to shatter it right away. Pressing the key does not cast it.
glyph.isekai_mahou.purity_on_debuff.desc: TRIGGER (Purity, at the start of the recipe). The slot casts BY ITSELF when another creature puts a bad effect of 2 s or more on you (poison, curse, slowness...), aiming at whoever applied it. Great for an automatic cleanse. Pressing the key does not cast it.
glyph.isekai_mahou.abyss_on_dive.desc: TRIGGER (Abyss, at the start of the recipe). The slot casts BY ITSELF when your head goes under water. Pressing the key does not cast it.
glyph.isekai_mahou.sand_on_blind.desc: TRIGGER (Sand, at the start of the recipe). The slot casts BY ITSELF at the target when you Blind an enemy (Sand in the Eyes, potions, spells). Pressing the key does not cast it.
glyph.isekai_mahou.crystal_on_petrify.de: TRIGGER (Crystal, at the start of the recipe). The slot casts BY ITSELF at the target when an enemy becomes fully Petrified by you. Pressing the key does not cast it.
glyph.isekai_mahou.gravity_on_slam.desc: TRIGGER (Gravity, at the start of the recipe). The slot casts BY ITSELF when an enemy you hurt in the last 5 s crashes to the ground from 3+ blocks, aiming at it. Combine with launches and Abyssal Anchor. Pressing the key does not cast it.
glyph.isekai_mahou.astral_on_teleport.de: TRIGGER (Astral, at the start of the recipe). The slot casts BY ITSELF when you teleport (ender pearl, chorus fruit, teleport spells, Star Step...), at most once per second. Pressing the key does not cast it.
glyph.isekai_mahou.void_on_erase.desc: TRIGGER (Void, at the start of the recipe). The slot casts BY ITSELF when an enemy you killed vanishes leaving nothing behind (no items, or erased by Annihilate). Pressing the key does not cast it.
glyph.isekai_mahou.twilight_on_threshold: TRIGGER (Twilight, at the start of the recipe). The slot casts BY ITSELF whenever your health crosses half, dropping below 50% or climbing back above it. Pressing the key does not cast it.
